text:
Nina (CS): FYI we have ~8 trial/onboard tenants stuck in provisioning for Dedicated pools in eu-west-1. Customers report onboarding stuck at \"Waiting for capacity\" and some are flagging renewal concerns. Opening thread to coordinate comms and mitigation.

Diego (Infra): Investigating. Looks like the tenant-provisioner failed to allocate GPUs due to a recent quota-check change. The new gate rejects requests when spot quota < requested.

Priya (Eng): Reproducer: create_tenant flow hits `quota_check()` -> early-return on borderline value. We merged that gate yesterday to reduce overcommit but missed a fallback path.

Omar (SRE): Rolling a hotfix to re-enable the fallback path. Will re-run stalled provision jobs. ETA ~18m. No loss of customer data; provisioning requests are idempotent.

Carl (Support): Ticket list: ONB-223, ONB-227, ONB-231, ONB-238. Customers asking for ETA and whether their trial will be extended.

Nina (CS): Action items for comms: 1) send short status to affected customers now; 2) prepare an exec-level RCA for accounts in renewal window; 3) propose remediation (trial extension + 1-on-1 onboarding session).

Priya (Eng): Draft short status: \"We identified an allocation issue affecting dedicated provisioning in eu-west-1 between 09:129:30 UTC; fix applied and provisioning retried. No data lost and we're queuing re-provisions now. We'll follow up when your tenant is active. Sorry for the disruption.\"

Nina (CS): Good. For renewal-risk accounts we should offer 2-week trial extension + priority onboarding time. For non-renewal trialers offer 72-hour extension. Keep templates separate.

Diego (Infra): Hotfix deployed at 09:28 UTC, backlog drain started at 09:31 UTC. I'm monitoring re-provision jobs; 6/8 succeeded so far. Attaching job IDs to tickets.

Omar (SRE): Added alert rule: if provisioning queue > 5 for >5m, block deploys to quota code-path and notify infra-oncall. Also added health-check: `provisioner.smoke.create_tenant()` every 5m.

Carl (Support): Sending short status to all open tickets now. Copy of message: \"We're on it 1; fix deployed; we'll update when your tenant is ready. Apologies for the interruption.\"

Nina (CS): For exec RCA draft include timeline, root cause (quota gate + missing fallback), impact (8 provision attempts delayed, 6 recovered automatically, 2 require manual retry), customer-facing mitigations, and long-term preventions (canary, gating, telemetry).

Priya (Eng): Prevention items to list: revert aggressive quota block, require explicit canary flag for quota policy, add integration test covering `create_tenant` under low-quota conditions, and document fallback semantics.

Nina (CS): Compensation proposal: renewal-risk accounts -> 2-week extension + 2-hr ops onboarding; trial accounts -> 72h extension. Approve? :thinking_face:

Diego (Infra): Approve from infra side. Recommend we also offer a one-time credit if customer experienced internal demo failure.

Omar (SRE): Confirming final state: all but 2 tenants active; manual retries scheduled for the last two at 10:05 UTC. I'll update tickets on completion.

NotifyBot: Manual retry jobs completed for ONB-231 and ONB-238 at 10:07 UTC 1:success:

Nina (CS): Great. I'll send the short status now and follow with the personalized exec RCA and compensation offers by 13:00 UTC. Carl 1 please paste ticket updates when done.

Carl (Support): Short status posted. I'll follow up with compensation notes after Nina shares the templates.

Nina (CS): Also scheduling two office hours for tomorrow: 15:00 UTC (general) and 17:00 UTC (high-touch). Will include a 1-question survey post-session to capture feedback for our onboarding flow improvements.

Priya (Eng): Adding follow-up to product board: reduce tight coupling between quota checks and deploy gating. @Product please triage.

Nina (CS): Thanks team. I'll post final sent copies and attendee list here after sends. Closing thread for now. :white_check_mark:
